maya: quick heads-up from onboarding sirocco60k-int4x: reproducible KV-index wrap when enabling RoPE cyclic-rescale and prefill coalesce. happens near a non-power boundary (~57123). tiny repro + logs below. :thinking:

hugo: can you paste the minimal repro and where you ran it?

maya: ran on staging (2xA100). repro command:
```
python infra/run_infer.py --model sirocco60k-int4x-v0 --quant int4x --rope-rescale cyclic \
  --context 60000 --prefill examples/long_release_notes.prefill --coalesce-prefill true \
  --dump-kv /tmp/siro_kv.json --seed 7
```

maya: log tail:
```
[2026-11-15T03:21:10Z] prefill complete pos=57118
[2026-11-15T03:21:11Z] generate start pos=57118
[kv] index_wrap detected at pos=57120 stored=0x9f11 expected=0x9f12
[emit] 57120="the"
[emit] 57121="the"  <-- repeat/dup
[fallback] rebuild-kv triggered -> latency bump
```

tess: that index_wrap wording suggests our debug shim detected a page index rollover. does the dump show two consecutive positions mapped to identical page:offset?

maya: kv dump excerpt (pos -> page:offset, key_hash):
```
57118 -> 14:1020  0x1a1b
57119 -> 14:1021  0x2c2d
57120 -> 0:0000   0x9f11  <- stored
57121 -> 0:0000   0x9f11  <- expected 0x9f12
```

hugo: tiled int4x stores local offsets in 11 bits for this build. if coalesce moves a page boundary and cyclic rescale recomputes per-pos hash, a narrow offset can wrap. try setting TILED_LOCAL_BITS=16 at runtime to test.

maya: quick smoke with TILED_LOCAL_BITS=16 fixed the duplicate. int8/fp16 unaffected. disabling cyclic rescale also fixes it.

ops-bot: created INC-2026-2727: "sirocco60k int4x KV index wrap with cyclic RoPE rescale + coalesce" and linked this thread. Assigned to maya.

qa-bot: suggested regression added: longprefill-coalesce (32k/48k/60k) across fp16/int8/int4x with cyclic/per-layer/no rescale; verify kv page maps and token sequence diffs. Low-cost smoke to add to onboarding.

hugo: action items:
- maya: open runtime PR to widen tiled local offset from 11->16 bits for int4x compaction codepath and add a unit test that simulates coalesce at page boundary. include memory/perf delta in PR.
- tess: add suggested smoke to onboarding checklist and nightly regression matrix.
- maya: run token-diff bench fp16 vs int4x (cyclic rescale + widened offsets) overnight and upload diffs + kv dumps.

maya: perf note: widening local bits to 16 increases KV metadata by ~0.4% for sirocco60k config. acceptable tradeoff for correctness; will include numbers in PR.

hugo: if widening is unacceptable for some edge configs, consider changing coalesce remap to update a per-page base index instead of relying on narrow global math. but widening is straightforward and low-risk.

maya: thanks all, opening PR now and will paste link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
